infobox.usage: Unlocks the radar station commandant's office at the peninsula territory on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Radar station commandant room key (Radar) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens the radar station commandant office room, located somewhere on the Lighthouse peninsula territory.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the quest Top Secret

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The commandant's office can be found on the first floor of the radar station at the lighthouse peninsula territory on Lighthouse. Note: The bridge that leads to the peninsula is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables, Weapon mods)
- Jacket
- Weapon box (4x4)
- PC block
